hypotheses.title: Volatility-Adjusted Put Breakeven Distance (Sigma-Cushion Support)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Measures the distance from spot price to the institutional put breakeven support floor in units of the stock's own historical realized volatility (cushion_sigma = (close - put_breakeven) / (close * historical_volatility)). A fixed dollar cushion provides vastly different support across varying volatility regimes; evaluating the volatility-standardized distance identifies equities trading multi-sigma above dealer short-gamma flip points with structural downside protection across all market sectors.
confounders: Sudden volatility regime shifts inflating the denominator during market drawdowns
Stale open-interest pricing on illiquid option strikes
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms if market-wide realized volatility spikes rapidly through all historical baseline estimates.

candidates.expression: 0.85 * group_rank((close - ts_backfill(put_breakeven_30, 60)) / (close * ts_backfill(historical_volatility_30, 60) + 0.001 * close), subindustry) - 0.15 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)
candidates.rationale: Volatility-standardized put breakeven distance paired with 5-day liquidity reversal buffer

hypotheses.title: Breakeven Asymmetry Velocity: Structural Level & 5-Day Gamma Acceleration
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Direct velocity enhancement of Batch 150 C2 (which achieved Sharpe 0.88 and Sub-universe Sharpe 0.79 with zero self-correlation). Static breakeven levels capture established dealer positioning, but alpha generates highest margins during active repositioning. Measuring the 5-day rate of change in the breakeven asymmetry ratio (ts_delta(ratio, 5)) isolates stocks where institutional call accumulation is actively accelerating, providing immediate directional momentum.
confounders: Short-term post-earnings implied volatility crushes distorting ratio deltas
Gamma pinning during monthly expiration weeks
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha degrades if 5-day breakeven ratio expansions reflect speculative retail buying rather than institutional flow.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * group_rank((ts_backfill(call_breakeven_20, 60) - close) / (close - ts_backfill(put_breakeven_20, 60) + 0.01 * close), subindustry) + 0.40 * group_rank(ts_delta((ts_backfill(call_breakeven_20, 60) - close) / (close - ts_backfill(put_breakeven_20, 60) + 0.01 * close), 5), subindustry) - 0.15 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)
candidates.rationale: Blended 20-day breakeven asymmetry level and 5-day acceleration with short-term price reversal buffer

hypotheses.title: Cross-Asset Synergy: 20-Day Gamma Asymmetry & Idiosyncratic Risk Normalization
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Synthesizes two completely virgin datasets (option9 and model51) where the user has zero historical submissions. Pairs quadratic conviction on 20-day gamma breakeven asymmetry with 30d/360d idiosyncratic variance exhaustion. Because the two signals are driven by orthogonal structural mechanisms (dealer option gamma vs equity unsystematic risk post-panic recovery), their combined Sharpe compounds via Markowitz diversification while idiosyncratic turnover partially cancels.
confounders: Correlated market liquidity shocks impacting both options market makers and equity liquidity providers
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha inverts during broad systemic risk-off shocks where idiosyncratic risk normalization fails.

candidates.rationale: Orthogonal synthesis of nonlinear 20-day gamma asymmetry conviction and idiosyncratic risk exhaustion
